elements.name: Identically formatted adjacent runs allow a boundary insertion

steps.name: adjacent Word runs with identical direct formatting
I insert a character at their shared text boundary
the combined text includes the insertion with unchanged run properties

elements.name: Differing or interrupted boundary ownership refuses

steps.name: adjacent Word runs with "different direct formatting"
I attempt an insertion at their shared text boundary
the insertion refuses and retains the original archive

elements.name: Differing or interrupted boundary ownership refuses

steps.name: adjacent Word runs with "an intervening bookmark"
I attempt an insertion at their shared text boundary
the insertion refuses and retains the original archive

elements.name: Differing or interrupted boundary ownership refuses

steps.name: adjacent Word runs with "different run attributes"
I attempt an insertion at their shared text boundary
the insertion refuses and retains the original archive

name: Word normalised and paragraph-boundary edge cases
description: Failed folded candidates cannot hide later whole-character matches.

elements.name: A partial folded candidate does not consume a later valid character match

steps.name: a Word paragraph containing "sß"
I search with normalisation for "ss"
the search evidence is exactly "ß"

elements.name: A span ending in a paragraph separator remains inspection-only

steps.name: two scoped Word paragraphs containing "first" and "second"
I search for text ending at the paragraph separator
attempting to edit that cross-paragraph match refuses

name: Word replace-all reports independent refusals
description: Supported matches commit together while unsupported matches remain unchanged and reported.

elements.name: A wrapper refusal does not discard independent supported matches

steps.name: two plain Word matches and one hyperlink-owned match
I replace all occurrences of "red" with "blue"
two matches change and one unsupported match is reported
the hyperlink-owned text remains unchanged

elements.name: Replace-all skips matches already equal to the replacement

steps.name: two plain Word matches and one hyperlink-owned match
I replace all occurrences of "red" with "red"
all three matches are skipped without refusals or mutation

elements.name: Invalid XML replacement cannot commit any selected match

steps.name: two plain Word matches and one hyperlink-owned match
I replace all occurrences with an XML-illegal value
no match changes and the original package bytes remain exact

name: Word search story and view scope
description: Paragraph boundaries are explicit characters and historical evidence cannot authorise current edits.

elements.name: Search sees exactly one newline between paragraphs

steps.name: two scoped Word paragraphs containing "first" and "second"
I search for their text with an explicit paragraph separator
one cross-paragraph match reports the exact combined text
attempting to edit that cross-paragraph match refuses

elements.name: Historical-view matches are read-only

steps.name: scoped Word text with a tracked deletion
I search original-view text for "removed"
the historical match reports "removed"
editing the historical match refuses without mutation

elements.name: An explicit related story does not search the body instead

steps.name: scoped Word body and header text both equal to "repeat"
I search only the header story for "repeat"
exactly one match identifies the header story

name: Word span replacement with exact affix alignment
description: A replacement changes one proved interval and leaves surrounding run markup intact.

elements.name: Replacement keeps unchanged fragments in their source runs

steps.name: editable Word runs "pre Al" and "pha post"
I replace the exact span "Alpha" with "Omega"
the resulting run texts are "pre Omeg" and "a post"
all run properties and surrounding XML are byte-preserved

elements.name: Replacement keeps unchanged fragments in their source runs

steps.name: editable Word runs "Al" and "pha"
I replace the exact span "Alpha" with "Beta"
the resulting run texts are "Bet" and "a"
all run properties and surrounding XML are byte-preserved

elements.name: Replacement keeps unchanged fragments in their source runs

steps.name: editable Word runs "fee😀" and "caféEnd"
I replace the exact span "😀café" with "tea"
the resulting run texts are "feetea" and "End"
all run properties and surrounding XML are byte-preserved

elements.name: Repeated affix ambiguity refuses without consuming the target

steps.name: editable Word runs "Term" and "Term"
I attempt to replace "TermTerm" with "Term"
ambiguous alignment refuses with the original archive intact
the same span remains reusable for a different replacement

elements.name: A visible span across a hyperlink boundary cannot authorise an edit

steps.name: text split across a plain run and a hyperlink wrapper
I attempt to replace "Alpha" with "Omega"
wrapper-crossing replacement refuses with the original archive intact

name: Word whitespace preservation on successful edits
description: Changed text receives explicit XML space preservation without altering unrelated attributes.

elements.name: A single replacement adds the required preservation attribute

steps.name: a Word text leaf without XML space preservation
I replace its text with leading and trailing spaces
the changed leaf has XML space preserve and exact new text
its unrelated attribute bytes remain unchanged

elements.name: A selected batch adds one preservation attribute to a shared leaf

steps.name: two Word matches in a leaf without XML space preservation
a selected batch adds significant spaces to both matches
the saved leaf has one XML space preserve attribute
both replacements retain their significant spaces

name: XML line endings and attribute values retain original edit offsets
description: Decoded values follow XML normalization without reserializing untouched source bytes.

elements.name: Literal line endings normalize but no-op and edits use original offsets

steps.name: XML text containing mixed CRLF and CR line endings
I inspect its decoded character data
literal line endings are LF while numeric CR remains CR
a decoded-text no-op preserves the original bytes
a changed text leaf preserves surrounding original line endings

elements.name: Literal attribute whitespace differs from numeric character references

steps.name: an XML attribute with literal whitespace and numeric whitespace references
I inspect its decoded attribute value
literal attribute whitespace is spaces and numeric references retain their characters
a decoded-attribute no-op preserves its original lexical bytes

elements.name: Changed attribute whitespace round-trips without losing numeric characters

steps.name: an XML attribute with literal whitespace and numeric whitespace references
I replace the attribute with tab CR and LF characters
the changed attribute decodes to the requested characters
unrelated attributes and start-tag spacing remain byte-identical
